youtube.baslik: Does a cochlear implant make sound louder? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A cochlear implant does not amplify sound; it bypasses damaged hair cells and turns sound into an electrical code the auditory nerve can use. The sound processor processes sound, the coil sends the signal through the skin to the internal unit, and electrodes stimulate the nerve directly.

cumleler: Does a cochlear implant make sound louder?
